forks.actual: Orbitz targeted 12- to 17-year-olds and a “Jetsons mentality.”[^1]
forks.whatif: Bubble tea later made chewable drinks normal for adults. A version sold as a café drink rather than a teen novelty might have lasted longer. That is hindsight.

forks.actual: In 2015 the company said it no longer had the equipment to make Orbitz, despite steady requests.[^5]
forks.whatif: Keeping a small production line could have allowed occasional nostalgia runs, as other brands have done. Whether demand would cover the cost is unknown.
